meta.name: update-libcontainer
meta.description: Reimport Native Image's vendored libcontainer from a newer JDK while preserving local adaptations in a reviewable commit stack. Use when performing a full libcontainer update, replaying Native Image changes onto new upstream sources, resolving reimport conflicts, or reviewing such an update.

howto.what: 协助你按照规范步骤，从更新的JDK重新导入libcontainer代码，保留本地修改，生成可审查的提交栈。自动处理基线查找、三路合并、冲突解决和一致性验证。

howto.what_en: Helps you reimport the vendored libcontainer from a newer JDK while preserving local adaptations, producing a reviewable commit stack. Automates baseline identification, three-way merge, conflict resolution, and consistency verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to perform a full libcontainer update, replay Native Image changes onto new upstream sources, resolve reimport conflicts, or review such an update.
